notes.title: More than 15 new levels!
notes.content:
[h2]Friends, we have important news![/h2]
We have just finished working on new levels and we are in a hurry to tell you about them. But in addition to the new levels, we have also redesigned existing locations, adding more forks for different levels of players — someone likes hardcore, and "casual" routes will suit someone :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43867708/11bde419d965bd82cc3682dbacda90a83f00c2a7.png[/img]

New levels are built on completely new locations, manually created game worlds. We also took care of the variety of gameplay, so at some levels you will get more freedom and the opportunity to plot your own route.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43867708/d8ecfceee4fc9b6efe1adb117947c67da0263a2a.png[/img]

Playing with friends will become more fun! Call your friends and start the mode for 2, 3 or 4 players and find out whose route will be the shortest, or who will be more experienced in overcoming untouched natural massifs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43867708/0054cd188f030a196138a06121c1b0cdeafc4f5e.png[/img]

We are proud to announce a new night location. If you have watched horror movies or play horror, then you will definitely like our new location — the Highway. This is a completely night level, illuminated only by roadside lanterns. What you will meet on the road remains a mystery...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43867708/2fa5ee4d9c47a35b735f3277437e37899fabbe3e.png[/img]

A huge number of new dynamic tracks for your trips! We have diversified the game playlist and new locations, including updated old ones, will sound even more exciting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43867708/0fee5c6af9c404cf190e5dcf4a23ad439fb91833.png[/img]

[h3]The release of the game may take place in July. At the request of many players who have played the demo version of BIKEOUT, we have revised our plans for the release of the game and will try to finish the game by July (and not by September, as originally planned).[/h3]
